discovery: Natural centered-write basis/mean from original2048 sites. Response bases from existing512-row normalized-input cache18536–19047, uncentered native MLP changes pooled over even heads or all heads. Residual basis is earlier frozen atlas; weight basis from Down Down^T. No new test selection.

predictions.selection_bias: Compare selected-four natural and full-response energy coverage, per-head energy shares, and head3 share inside versus outside the four-coordinate projection. High concentration only in the selected projection limits source-specific generality.
predictions.response_geometry: At rank64 response-derived basis improves full response energy coverage >=.10 over natural-write basis, without claiming an executable compressed input program.
predictions.source_transfer: Compare even-fit and all-fit response bases on odd heads, especially head3; both are fixed across sources at evaluation.
predictions.downstream: Compare full nonlinear suffix fidelity of equal-rank response versus natural bases. Local response energy coverage need not predict behavioral preservation.

finite_definition: At one destination remove an attention head write, holding the value bus and other positions unchanged. Gold uses the native MLP on changed pre-state. No-response control uses the original destination MLP write on that same changed pre-state. Approximation adds an orthogonal projection of the exact MLP change to the original write. All suffix blocks recompute. Mediation fidelity uses gold minus no-response as denominator; intact logits report the broader head-removal effect separately. These are response communication/sufficiency tests with an oracle exact response, not learned forward decoders or additive mediation shares.
scope: Full1152-dimensional L8 outputs, all nine local head responses; finite downstream tests head1/head3 on64 sites each. One model and corpus; no semantic naming or unique feature-basis claim.
